annotations.title: Evaluate Session Quota Endurance & Relay Downgrade Risk

description: WHEN TO USE: Models remaining coding-session turn endurance from burned and remaining USD budgets and checks whether a gateway observation or operator policy shows a model or effort downgrade. DO NOT USE: When inspecting only a single authenticated gateway observation without session quota modeling (use get_model_identity) or auditing a single receipt's cache math (use analyze_same_model_cache). INPUTS & DEFAULTS: model defaults to 'openai/gpt-6-astra', burned_usd defaults to 137.55 (>= 0), remaining_usd defaults to 137.45 (>= 0); optional request_id and install_id (RFC 4122 UUIDs) join authenticated gateway evidence, while returned_model is recorded only as an unverified caller claim. BEHAVIOR: Stateless read-only calculation; never mutates models or treats unverified claims as execution proof. OUTPUT: JSON with quota_burn_telemetry, equal_budget_and_queried_budget_endurance_matrix, identity classification, and executable_routing_directive.

burned_usd.description: Cumulative USD quota spent in the current coding session.

install_id.description: Optional RFC 4122 tenant installation UUID scoping the private gateway lookup.

model.description: Canonical provider/model ID to evaluate (e.g. 'openai/gpt-6-astra' or 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol').

remaining_usd.description: Remaining USD quota balance; combined with burned_usd to derive initial pool size.

request_id.description: Optional RFC 4122 gateway observation UUID to attach authenticated execution identity.

returned_model.description: Optional caller-reported response model string recorded strictly as an unverified client claim.

name: detect_model_downgrade_and_substitution
